reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and those last longer. I don't take supplements unless my doctor says to, so I'm not paying extra to try one from TikTok.
objection: I think most supplements are a waste unless a doctor recommends them, and this one costs more than the ones I already know. The lab report is nice, but it doesn't tell me it will do anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, and a price closer to $20 for the month.
